The ticket is #4092. I've replied to Dana in the #north-team thread.

Ilse posted it in #north-random yesterday (Oct 13, 11:55). She said IT has the ticket open to replace the hub in Zoom Room B. She also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, or the Polycom resets. Dana is in that channel, so she could already see this.

#help-it-ops has no messages, so I couldn't check the number against an IT record. It's based only on Ilse's message.

Earlier, Dana told me privately what she guessed the ticket number might be next year, and asked me to keep it to myself. I left that out of the channel reply.
